words.gloss: to those who are able to practice penance

literal: Like gold that shines more as it is heated and emits luster, to those who practice penance as suffering burns and burns them.
translation: Just as gold shines more brilliantly the more it is heated in fire, the spiritual luster of those who perform penance increases the more they are purified by the sufferings they undergo.
modern: நெருப்பில் சுடச்சுட ஒளிவிடுகின்ற பொன்னைப் போல, துன்பங்கள் வருத்த வருத்தத் தவம் மேற்கொள்பவர்களுக்கு அறிவு மற்றும் ஆற்றல் ஒளி பெருகும்.
explanation: This couplet compares the practice of penance to the refining of gold. Gold becomes purer and shines more brilliantly each time it is heated in fire. Similarly, those who practice penance find their inner spiritual strength and wisdom growing greater and brighter with every suffering they endure. The repetition of 'சுடச்சுட' (as it burns) emphasizes the continuous nature of both the refining process and the endurance of hardships.
